note: The why gives the learner the tool to check themselves (smooth means in tune, a wobble means off), the bare drill stays at 3 minutes, and the second block turns it into a tune the learner makes up in a new key.

exercise.title: In tune over a drone: find the smooth spot
exercise.focus: Do and Sol over a D drone · a made-up Do Mi Sol tune over A
exercise.why: A note in tune with the drone sounds smooth and a note that is off wobbles, so the drone teaches your ear to hear in tune on its own.

sections.text: Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows on the staff as a line. Sing {{1}} on "ah" and slide a little above it and below it, until the wobble stops and the sound goes smooth. That smooth spot is in tune. Then find it on {{5}}.

Press Start exercise below: the drone is on A now. Make up short tunes from {{1}}, {{3}} and {{5}}, on "la", and end each one on {{1}}. The notes change, the pattern doesn't: listen again for the smooth spot on every note.
